facts.summary: Character bodies have transforms, bounding boxes, hierarchy and local scalar deforms; boxes alone do not establish collision use.
Internal body targets and game-provided external targets adapt motion; reciprocal hand targets are an example, not a surface-contact or collision guarantee.

facts.summary: Published system does not understand volume/boundaries, cannot effectively express certain contact motions, and ignores intra-character collision. Boundary-relative reasoning is future work.

algorithms: Capsule proxies from edited reference geometry and current local/body pose
